reason: I buy Monster or Big Shock in 4-packs on offer, so I pay maybe 30-35 CZK a can. 55 CZK for a smaller 330 ml can with 80 mg of caffeine is almost double per can, and I don't care enough about 'natural' to pay that every time.
objection: Price per can. It costs more than a Red Bull and has less in it than a big Monster, and I'd also have to order online or find it in some café.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack deal online that brings it down to around 35-40 CZK a can, or seeing it on offer in a normal supermarket next to the gym.
